# Little CMS 2.19.1

Unmodified `include/`, `src/`, and `LICENSE` from the upstream stable release:
https://github.com/mm2/Little-CMS/releases/tag/lcms2.19.1

Archive: `lcms2-2.19.1.tar.gz`
SHA-256: `bfc54f7bab59fbc921012014a8032e4cba4abd46db47d46b76416a8c0b2815c8`

MIT license, reproduced in LICENSE and copied into the Windows distribution.
Only the Windows display pipeline uses this library. Measurement calculations,
saved values, standard RGB readouts and exports do not use a monitor profile.
The native library is built locally from these sources; no downloaded DLL is used.
